title: The View From HQ, Episode 1: Mark Zagorski
summary: Watch DV CEO Mark Zagorski discuss how social, streaming TV and agentic AI are reshaping advertising — and how DV is ready for every challenge and opportunity.
body_markdown:
Our new video series,


**The View From HQ** ,


**** takes a look at adtech from the inside. We’ll sit down with DV subject matter experts to get their perspective on emerging trends and upcoming solutions.


We’re going straight to the top for episode one! Chief Executive Officer Mark Zagorski shares his take on DV’s expanding presence in social and CTV, the new opportunity and challenge of AI advertising, and DV’s unique superpower.
